name: 01801 · Woburn, MA
findings: ZIP 01801 (Woburn) has 208 nonprofit organizations. 76 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 65 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01801 (Woburn) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 01801 (Woburn) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 65 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
